facts.fact: Algerie Telecom, the state telco, inaugurated its new Constantine data centre, built by its own teams and equipped with a cloud platform for collecting, processing and storing enterprise data; the document gives no event date beyond 'today' in a statement made 'this week', so its published date 2023-03-01 is used.

systems.country_label: data center of Algeria Telecom in Constantine

note: Document also says only local players HostArts, Ayrade, ICOSNET and ISSAL offer hosting, mostly in Algiers or Oran, naming no facility; not recorded as a fact.
